items.source: Fluent method to specify scan consistency. Scan consistency may also come from an annotation.
items.translation: 指定扫描一致性的流畅方法。扫描一致性也可能来自注解。

items.source: consistentWith in interface ConsistentWith<T>
items.translation: consistentWith 在接口 ConsistentWith<T> 中

items.source: T - the entity type to use for the results.
items.translation: T - 用于结果的实体类型。

items.source: mutationState - the custom scan consistency to use for this query.
items.translation: mutationState - 用于此查询的自定义扫描一致性级别。
